newsitem.title: PANAMA: Panama public workers end strike over pension.
newsitem.headline: Panama public workers end strike over pension.

text.p: Panamanian public sector workers ended Wednesday a general strike after reaching an agreement with the government that proposed pension reforms would be delayed until the end of 1999.
"It was the best we could achieve," said public sector union Fenasep leader Luis Alberto Prescott.
But Teachers Union secretary Mario Medina accused Fenasep of selling-out to the government, and said his union would continue to protest the reforms.
Under the agreement, special pension benefits will be paid up to the end of the century, but thereafter public sector workers will move towards a Chilean-style fully-funded pension system.
The government has said without the reforms the state's pension system will be nearly $4 billion in the red by the year 2025.
